group.name: Tokyo Institute of Technology
group.description: Tokyo Tech is a research university that equips students with the technical knowledge and leadership skills to understand and create solutions to global challenges. Home to some of the world’s leading researchers in science and technology, Tokyo Tech’s three campuses provide an open learning and research environment that encourages out-of-the-box, interdisciplinary approaches to achieve sustainable development and well-being for humankind. Graduates of the Institute consistently rank highly in domestic and international employability rankings.
